snippet.title: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Coaster Rush | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:
GOG Preservation Program! 
https://www.youtube.com/@gogclassicsvault
Follow us on:

Twitch: 👉  https://bit.ly/3vVI6CJ
Twitter: 👉  https://bit.ly/3fdOUFK
Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

Oddsparks is a great entry point into automation games, but with a fresh spin for those who’ve already played thousands of hours in the genre. You’ll design automated workshops and put your Sparks to work in carrying and crafting everything you could need - including more Sparks!

Get ready for a theme park frenzy! The Coaster Rush expansion blends intricate automation with spectacular, heart-pounding theme park elements. Give your Sparks the adventure they deserve, and inject pure, joyous excitement into your logistics network with incredible coaster-style train tracks!
